messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: Atlas is taking over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-08-15] standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2: Team Boreal still owns the bus, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11: If the event bus is down, the notification service is down: it relies on it for delivery events.
- [2025-04-18] standup/boreal/2025-04-18: Deploys to the event bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-06-19] standup/boreal/2025-06-19: As before, webhooks needs the event-bus to work.
- [2025-12-29] standup/dune/2025-12-29: Observation from team Dune: after the client rollout, the event-bus' request volume halved.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2: If the bus is down, the webhooks service is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: Boreal looks after the bus.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23-2: Team Dune noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for team Atlas goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-05-29] standup/ember/2026-05-29: On-call rotation: Oskar is primary for team Ember starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar takes the first the Ember team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20: Marcus moves from team Boreal to the Atlas team today. On-call for Boreal passes from Marcus to Lena with the move.
- [2026-01-15] standup/ember/2026-01-15: On-call rotation: Diego is primary for Ember starting today; Oskar is off rotation.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-03-03] handover/2025-03-03-webhooks: From today the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-02-12] standup/atlas/2025-02-12: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-09-23] handover/2025-09-23-scheduler: From today the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-01-09] standup/cinder/2025-01-09: Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.
- [2026-01-16] standup/dune/2026-01-16: On-call rotation: Farah Haddad is primary for team Dune starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2025-07-30] standup/atlas/2025-07-30: Team change: Tomasz leaves team Atlas and joins team Dune, effective today. On-call for Atlas passes from Tomasz to Priya with the move.
- [2026-01-12] handover/2026-01-12-billing-api: Quick one: billing-api belongs to the Ember team starting today. Thanks to the Atlas team for running it until now.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the product catalog.

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns the event-bus?

message.reasoning:
The event-bus ownership: Boreal owned it (2025-01-09, 2025-08-15). Then 2025-11-24 handover: Atlas takes over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. No later entry supersedes that. Today is 2026-06-30, so Atlas owns the event-bus now.

On-call for Atlas: Priya primary from 2025-02-12; Tomasz left Atlas 2025-07-30, on-call passes from Tomasz to Priya. The 2026-05-27 entry mentions Atlas standup but no on-call change. So Priya is on call for Atlas.
